title: TRUNC
definition: Truncates a number to a specified number of decimal places without rounding.

title: ABS
definition: ABS(): Returns the absolute value of a number.

title: CEIL
definition: CEIL() / CEILING(): Rounds a number up to the nearest integer.

title: FLOOR
definition: FLOOR(): Rounds a number down to the nearest integer

title: SQRT
definition: SQRT(): Returns the square root of a number

title: MOD
definition: MOD(): Returns the remainder of a division operation

title: POWER
definition:
Raises a numeric value to a specified power.
The function calculates the value of the column raised to the given exponent (x^n). This is useful for mathematical calculations such as squares, cubes, or exponential scaling.

title: LOG
definition:
Returns the natural logarithm of a numeric value.
The function calculates the logarithm of the value using base e (Euler's number). This is commonly used in mathematical calculations, data normalization, and exponential growth analysis.

title: EXP
definition:
Returns the exponential value of a numeric column.
The function calculates e raised to the power of the column value (e^x). This is commonly used in mathematical models, growth calculations, and inverse operations of the logarithm function.
